title: Bigelow refuses to return; negative experiences hit his family

tellings.quote: he had such negative experiences. It it impacted his family.

plain: The businessman Robert Bigelow, who once owned Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, refuses to go back there because he had such bad experiences that they affected his family. The ranch's current owner tells Michels this, drawing on Bigelow and on a man named George Knapp. If true, whatever goes on at the ranch would follow people home.
